products.title: VOILA! 200ML
products.body_html:
VOILA – BY GISSAH


Eau de Parfum – 200 ML – Women

DESCRIPTION


Voila by Gissah is a soft, feminine, and gracefully radiant fragrance crafted to embody elegance, innocence, and effortless charm.
It opens with a delicate trio of Mandarin, Orange Flower, and Heliotrope — bright, floral, and gently uplifting.

The heart reveals a warm, sweet blend of Honey, Jasmine, and Rose, adding depth, softness, and unmistakable femininity.
As the fragrance settles, a smooth and sensual base of Musk and Amber creates a glowing, long-lasting trail that feels both refined and comforting.

A scent that makes you soar, shine, and captivate effortlessly — Voila celebrates the beauty, strength, and light within every woman.

products.title: HARLEQUIN CREAM
products.body_html:
HARLEQUIN CREAM – Eau De Parfum – 75 ML – Unisex

By Lattafa – Give Me Gourmand Collection

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

DESCRIPTION

Harlequin Cream by Lattafa is an irresistibly playful gourmand fragrance inspired by the delicious experience of Neapolitan ice cream. Launched in 2026 as part of the Give Me Gourmand Collection, it blends creamy ice cream, whipped cream, warm waffle, vanilla, cocoa, and soft musk into a comforting dessert-inspired signature.

The fragrance opens with a Neapolitan ice cream accord, creating an immediately creamy and indulgent introduction. Vanilla-like creaminess blends with rich chocolate and sweet fruity facets, giving the opening the delicious character of freshly served ice cream.

At its heart, whipped cream and waffle create a fluffy, warm gourmand accord. Airy whipped cream adds smooth sweetness, while waffle introduces a cozy baked character that makes the fragrance feel even richer and more dessert-like.

As it settles, vanilla, musk, and cocoa create a soft and comforting foundation. Creamy vanilla reinforces the sweetness, cocoa adds chocolatey depth, and musk provides a smooth finish that keeps the composition soft and wearable.

Creamy, fluffy, and unapologetical

products.title: RISK COMETE
products.body_html:
RISK COMÈTE – Eau de Parfum – 125 ML – Women

By ASSAF | Arrogate Collection

 

DESCRIPTION

Risk Comète by Assaf is a fragrance born from a fleeting moment that leaves a lasting impression. Bold yet refined, it captures the delicate balance between softness and dominance, desire and restraint — a scent that speaks of confidence without ever asking for permission.

This is not a fragrance that reveals itself at first glance. Instead, it unfolds layer by layer, much like a woman whose presence cannot be fully understood in a single moment. Every phase tells a different story — elegant, sensual, daring, and unforgettable.

The opening is luminous and intriguing, setting a graceful tone that immediately draws attention. As the fragrance evolves, it reveals a feminine heart that blends softness with warmth, creating a smooth and captivating aura. In the dry-down, a sensual and comforting base lingers on the skin, leaving a refined trail that stays long after you’ve passed.

Risk Comète is not meant to please everyone — it is a declaration. A fragrance for women who embrace their power, trust their presence, and redefine elegance on their own terms.

products.body_html:
MALLOW MADNESS – LATTAFA (Give Me Gourmand Collection)


Eau de Parfum – 75 ML – Unisex

DESCRIPTION
Mallow Madness is a playful, cozy, and delightfully sweet gourmand fragrance crafted for lovers of fluffy, creamy dessert scents.
It opens with a juicy, mouthwatering burst of Strawberry and Raspberry — bright, fruity, and instantly addictive.

The heart reveals a soft, cloud-like blend of Marshmallow and Freesia, adding sweetness, warmth, and a gentle floral touch.
As it settles, the base melts into a creamy fusion of Vanilla, Whipped Cream, and Musk, creating a smooth, comforting finish that lingers beautifully on the skin.

Sweet, soft, and irresistibly charming, Mallow Madness captures the essence of marshmallow bliss in a refined, wearable perfume suitable for any season.

DESCRIPTION

The Kingdom by Lattafa is a refined masculine fragrance that blends aromatic freshness, rich tobacco, and warm oriental accords into a powerful and sophisticated signature. Designed for the modern gentleman, this elegant composition delivers confidence, depth, and timeless appeal, making it an excellent choice for both everyday wear and evening occasions.

The fragrance opens with sage, lavender, and mint, creating a crisp and invigorating introduction. Aromatic sage and lavender provide a clean, sophisticated freshness, while mint adds a cool, energizing touch that makes the opening vibrant and effortlessly elegant.

At the heart, tobacco, vanilla, and orange flower unfold into a rich and captivating accord. Smooth tobacco is softened by creamy vanilla, while orange flower introduces a refined floral brightness, creating a heart that is warm, balanced, and irresistibly masculine.

As it settles, benzoin, tonka bean, and labdanum create a luxurious and long-lasting foundation. Resinous benzoin blends seamlessly with the creamy sweetness of tonka bean and the rich warmth of labdanum, leaving behind a smooth, ambery, and sophisticated trail.

By Lattafa

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

DESCRIPTION

The Kingdom by Lattafa is a luxurious feminine fragrance that embodies grace, sweetness, and timeless sophistication.

Crafted for the modern woman, this fragrance blends juicy fruits, creamy gourmand notes, and warm sensual woods into a beautifully balanced composition that feels elegant, charming, and unforgettable. The Kingdom is designed to celebrate femininity with softness, confidence, and lasting beauty.

The fragrance opens with pear, black currant, and peony, creating a fresh and fruity introduction where juicy sweetness meets soft floral brightness. This opening feels vibrant, delicate, and instantly captivating.

At the heart, praline, tonka bean, and jasmine unfold, adding a rich gourmand sweetness wrapped in floral elegance. This stage feels creamy, smooth, and deeply feminine, bringing warmth and sophistication to the composition.

As it settles, musk, vanilla, sandalwood, and amber create a warm and sensual base, leaving behind a creamy, musky, and woody trail that feels comforting, luxurious, and beautifully long-lasting.

Sweet, elegant, and irresistibly feminine — The Kingdom is a fragrance crafted for women who seek luxury, charm, and timeless beauty in every spray.
